   **Bugs and stability.**
      16 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 20, 2026 - Nov 19, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _BlA387532_, Sep 24, 2026, 1/5: "The amount of times it glitches is absolutely uncanny. And that for 700€+ per year. Currently looking for an alternative."
            2. _vevenissa_, Oct 2, 2026, 2/5: "The app is absolutely amazing in itself but for god’s sake please fix the bugs. My app crashes at least once a day and I use it daily for note taking in lectures. It becomes such a hassle when the app refuses to let me type anything mid lecture and i miss very important info. I’m considering using other apps despite Notion being so handy for organization."
            3. _SirCC_, Nov 19, 2026, 3/5: "Notion is fine, but the iPad app is littered with poor design and weird bugs. The sidebar doesn’t work properly at all, you can’t access the right sidebar, the various open page as options don’t work (side peek ect.), and the list goes on. A safari web app works better, which isn’t ideal at all. Please fix it."
